items.Sentence: The WWTF consists a 5,000-gallon concrete storage tank septage receiving station, a headworks (including a manual bar screen and grinder), influent flow meter, two aerated equalization basins, four aeration basins, four rectangular secondary clarifiers, chlorine contact basins, effluent flow meter, and two effluent storage tanks (storage capacity of 10,000 gallons and 250,000 gallons).
